intro: Make room for the work that matters. Edit, organize and transform your PDFs with tools that work on your device.
heading: A tool for every next step.
upload: Choose files or drop them here
limits: 40 MB total · 300 pages · Original files stay unchanged
privacy: Your documents stay in browser memory. They are not uploaded to Parperly or Firebase. Account details are handled by Firebase Authentication.
privacyNote: Local processing, clear controls and original files left untouched.
noHistory: Your completed jobs will appear here. Files are never saved in this history.
unavailable: This workflow is not available in this release.
faq1: Do my files leave this device?
faq2: Can I edit existing PDF text?
answer2: The editor adds new text, highlights, shapes and images. Existing text replacement, secure redaction and certificate signatures are not supported.
answer3: OCR, Office conversion, encryption, repair and advanced compression need isolated processing engines. Their pages explain the exact requirement.
